players.detail: Tweaked his calf during pregame warmups Aug. 21 and did not play against Denver. Matt LaFleur said Aug. 24 that Brinson will miss some time; no specific return date was given.

Left the Aug. 21 preseason game and was evaluated after the play. Reporting noted a possible concussion evaluation, but no diagnosis or confirmed return has been established, so he remains a monitor case.
Sustained an ankle issue during the Aug. 21 preseason game and was limited to two offensive snaps. No confirmed return has been established.
Played a limited number of snaps against Denver while dealing with a calf issue. No setback or confirmed return to full work has been established.
Remained sidelined through the latest confirmed practice reporting with a foot issue. No return has been confirmed yet.
Remained sidelined through the latest confirmed practice reporting after an ankle issue. No return has been confirmed yet.
Continues to receive team work during his managed return from a knee injury. No new setback has been reported.
Remained on the PUP list through the latest confirmed practice reporting; no activation has been reported.
Remained on PUP through the latest confirmed practice reporting while recovering from an Achilles injury.
Remains on PUP with a calf issue. Matt LaFleur said Aug. 24 that Orzech may not return this week and that his recovery could still take some time.
Remained on the PUP list through the latest confirmed practice reporting with a neck issue.

recentReturns.detail: Returned to practice Aug. 24 after leaving the Aug. 21 preseason game with a knee issue. Matt LaFleur said he was good to go, and Cisse was observed participating in defensive-back drills.
Returned to practice Aug. 18 after a groin injury. Matt LaFleur said Aug. 24 that Jacobs will progress into team drills this week.
Returned to team work while managing knee tendinitis. Matt LaFleur said Aug. 24 that Banks is trending in the right direction and is on pace to be ready for the regular season.
Returned for the Aug. 20 walkthrough after leaving an earlier practice late with a stinger.
Returned to practice after missing time with a knee issue and was available for the Aug. 20 walkthrough.
Returned to practice after missing time with an illness and was available for the Aug. 20 walkthrough.

Returned to team work Aug. 16 and has continued taking team reps as part of his managed ACL comeback.

Returned to practice after a brief absence/rehab period.
